plan.title: The Small Brewery's "TTB-Ready" Report of Operations Generator
plan.problem: Small craft breweries struggle with the tedious, error-prone, and high-risk task of manually compiling the mandatory federal Brewer's Report of Operations (BROP).
plan.targetCustomer: The owner or head brewer of a small craft brewery producing under 10,000 barrels per year.
plan.payer: The owner or head brewer of a small craft brewery.
plan.whyPayerPays: The payer spends money to eliminate the tedious, error-prone, and high-risk task of manually compiling the BROP, primarily to mitigate the risk of federal audits and penalties.
